recommendations.text: Add quantifiable achievements to your experience section. Use numbers, percentages, and metrics (e.g., 'Reduced load time by 40%', 'Managed team of 8 engineers').
Use strong action verbs to start your bullet points. Words like 'Architected', 'Optimized', 'Spearheaded', 'Implemented', and 'Delivered' make a stronger impression.

ats_suggestions.text: Consider incorporating these JD keywords: field, hands, cloud, platforms, plus. ATS systems often rank resumes by keyword match frequency.
Avoid using tables in your resume — many ATS systems cannot parse table content correctly.
Your resume appears quite short. Consider adding more detail to your experience and skills sections.
